hypothesis: Increasing only CNN width will improve validation macro-F1 and accuracy compared with the class-weighted small CNN, without worsening fault-to-normal errors.
test_policy: Do not run predictions or select settings on the test split.
budget_rationale: Two-batch smoke implies roughly 7.2 seconds per full training pass and 1.1 seconds per validation pass, before prediction collection and overhead. A 15-epoch run may exceed 120 seconds; stop at the 120-second cap if so.
stopping_rule: Stop after 15 epochs, two epochs without validation macro-F1 improvement, or 120 elapsed seconds, whichever comes first.
